where `f` and `g` coincide.

namespace CategoryTheory

variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F₁ F₂ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w} {A : Subpresheaf F₁}
  (f g : A.toPresheaf ⟶ F₂)

namespace Subpresheaf

`A.toPresheaf ⟶ F₂` with `A : Subpresheaf F₁`, as a subcomplex of `F₁`. -/
